subject: Minor change for sadd command (#2001)
reason: The change moves `server.dirty += added` inside the `if (added)` guard in saddCommand. When added == 0 the old code added 0 to server.dirty, which is a no-op, and when added > 0 both versions execute identically. The dirty counter delta (and thus replication propagation), keyspace notifications, and the SADD reply are unchanged in all cases, so this is a pure refactor with no behaviour change and needs no scenario.
